_comment: The starter sounds Crow Studio ships inside the bundle itself, read by server/library-store.js. Each entry is one file under library/files/, with the size and sha256 it is served by: the file route and a render both hash the bytes before anything plays them, so a name this list pins is worth something. `licence` and `credit` are what the picker shows beside the sound, and `source_url` is where the unmodified file came from — library/files/NOTICES.md carries the same facts for every file, plus the licences in full. A bundled entry reaches a song only through the person's own action (POST /api/studio/library/bundled); no agent can add one.
